study.question: Does supervising each click adapter coarse-sign view independently recover utility lost by probability averaging, at unchanged prediction graph, capacity and native normalization support?
study.hypothesis: Observed r0076 reflected probability averaging underperforms its signed duplicate by0.0022316063295204 click AUC. Mixture BCE can be minimized by complementary views without making each sign individually predictive; mean per-view BCE penalizes that compensation via a nonnegative Jensen gap. The narrow, unverified hypothesis is that weak-view supervision is a consequential optimization bottleneck for the coarse-only quotient. This is deliberately narrower than the already unsuccessful r0064 full-reversal per-view experiment and does not assume sign information is dispensable.

nearest_work.difference: Direct standalone source checked: unchanged local coarse-sign views, coalesced Linear execution and native4B Dice support; replace only click training objective through the registered hook. The matched mixture bridge is rerun because hook reduction changes cannot be assumed numerically neutral.

Existing per-view objective over whole-history reversed paired networks failed to restore utility. Here only the primary adapter coarse coordinate is reflected; summaries, interaction, auxiliaries and4B Dice support stay r0076. This adapts an existing local objective to a localized intervention; no novel objective claim.

Archived primary text lines227-284 verifies target-conditioned unnormalized weighted pooling and BCE, while reporting no benefit for its tested LSTM setting. We inherit adapted pooling; this local sign/objective factorial is not a DIN reproduction or evidence its result transfers.

Pinned benchmark forward lines119-156 uses sequence and feature tokens and unified interactions. None adopted; a whole-model replacement would confound this localized objective test. Original-author equivalence is unverified.
Pinned benchmark forward lines175-200 flattens embeddings into a tokenizer and mixing stack. None adopted; no flattening/mixing changes here and no priority claim.

inherited_components: All learned modules, initializations and source gradient gates from g1-r0076-reflect_fold_prediction; width16 click adapter and rank16 blockwise product context/history fusion
All supplied fields, history/task masks, five moment computations, compression, pruning and auxiliary routing
Coalesced primary tower, native4B click Dice population, three reflected or one duplicate affine representatives, and late FP32 probability averaging
Existing per-view BCE concept from g1-r0064-reversal_per_view, adapted to only the primary coarse-sign pair
study.proposed_difference: A2x2 factorial crosses reflect/duplicate coarse views with mixture/per_view click BCE. Every standalone module uses the same fresh-forward transient cache and computes both candidate losses; only reflect/per_view selects the mean view BCE. Duplication objectives select exactly the same loss expression. Auxiliaries keep one unweighted BCE each. At inference the objective flag has no effect. No added learned parameters, changed event order, loss weights, labels, optimizer, seed or training schedule.
predictions: At a common learned/buffer state, objective siblings have identical four-task predictions, normalization inputs and running-state updates. Duplicate objective loss/gradient/step states coincide. Reflection forward and per-view objective remain invariant to only the primary adapter coarse-vector sign exchange, within precision tolerances.

If weak-view supervision is consequential, the reflected per-view objective reduces view-specific training error/disagreement where measured and improves click AUC beyond the duplicate objective null; practical triage I>=0.0003 and at least25% of a gap G>=0.0005 recovered.

Per-view BCE is mathematically at least mixture BCE at fixed predictions, but a lower post-training validation loss/AUC improvement is empirical and not guaranteed. Exact toy calculation y=1,p+=0.9,p-=0.1 gives mixture BCE0.6931471805599453 and mean view BCE1.203972804325936.
No parameter-count or inference-graph increase within treatment; measured loss/backward wall cost may change. Cross-treatment3B/B affine work is measured rather than called compute matched.
falsifiers: If duplicate objectives differ in fixed-state loss/gradients/step or abs(D_V-D_M)>1e-5, clean objective attribution fails; preserve the discrepancy.

If controls pass but I<0.0003 or less than25% of an eligible gap is recovered, reject this practically consequential local objective-rescue hypothesis; preserve any smaller/negative effect without declaring order necessary.

If view supervision improves train agreement but validation remains worse, the bottleneck is not resolved by this objective; optimization, generalization, residual order information and normalization remain alternatives.
If new mixture bridges materially drift from r0076 or native diagnostics are unavailable, cross-round execution/gradient claims remain unresolved; within-suite outcomes remain preliminary.
alternative_explanations: Supplied coarse orientation genuinely carries predictive information; sign quotient discards it. Other order channels remain, so neither success nor failure establishes whole-order invariance or necessity.
Jensen penalty regularization, multi-task gradient coupling, single-pass optimization and native Dice support can alter outcomes without a pure information effect.
r0064 already failed with a related broader per-view objective; this new local scope may also fail, and a positive result cannot erase that negative branch.
BF16 geometry, reduction order or nondeterminism can explain old/new bridge drift; native diagnostics were not requested in existing receipts.
Adaptive reuse of one validation population and one seed, no authorized user-cluster uncertainty yet, inherited offline delayed-feedback semantics and benchmark point-in-time limitations.
